summary: NexPoint Capital filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events to announce its net asset value per share of $4.40 as of April 30, 2026, which also serves as the issuance price under its distribution reinvestment plan. The price is set by the adviser in its sole discretion and is not less than the determined NAV per share. This is a routine NAV disclosure and DRP pricing update for a closed-end fund, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, transactions, or strategic actions. No further events or actions are noted.
